# Repository Instructions

- Repository: `pegaflow-hust`
- Keep code, tests, experiments, paper assets, and provenance in this parent repository.
- Do not modify ambient sibling runtime checkouts. Use repo-owned submodules or patches.
- Use the dedicated project environment documented by this repository.
- Do not create `.venv` or `venv`.
- Do not report simulated, projected, or smoke evidence as real online results.
